description.value: Red Star Seafood Restaurant is a well-established Cantonese dining destination in Richmond, offering hundreds of classical dim sum dishes alongside live seafood, hot pot, and full banquet service for celebrations. One of two BC locations (the other on Granville Street in Vancouver), the Richmond branch seats diners in an elegant atmosphere and is a popular choice for family reunions and wedding banquets. Takeout and self-pickup orders are available from both locations.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 50m; rack at 90m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully fetched and corroborates the OSM record: Richmond location address (#2200 - 8181 Cambie Road), phone (604.270.3003), and website all match. The site explicitly promotes 'DINE-IN & TAKE OUT' service and 'SELF PICK UP' orders, confirming takeout. No evidence exists on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities, so those are null.
concerns: Website footer copyright reads '©2017 REDSTAR', suggesting the site may not have been updated recently, though content appears operationally current.
Front page marketing copy reads 'San Francisco's Most Acclaimed Asian Restaurant', which appears to be brand heritage language and does not affect the Richmond BC listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant with active website, confirmed address and phone, and publicly accessible dine-in and takeout service.

wow_evidence: well-established Cantonese dining destination... live seafood, hot pot, and full banquet service
